Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

The newspaper interviewed two different recently divorced people, one lesbian and the other bisexual, about their experiences in their first marriage. The lesbian one mentioned that they were the cause of the divorce after realizing that they really had no intention to remain monogamous, and the bisexual one said that their marriage had ended after their partner became distant but doesn't think either of them had trouble having just one partner. Who struggles with monogamy?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The bisexual one
C. The lesbian one
